questions.title: Truth: name one thing your partner regularly does that secretly annoys you. Why have you kept quiet about it?
Truth: if you could change one decision in your relationship, what would it be and how would things be different?
Truth: what compliment do you most want to hear from your partner, but have never had the courage to ask for?
Truth or Dare: what did you misunderstand about me at first? / Act out our first date as a movie trailer.
Truth or Dare: what habit of mine annoys you but you tolerate? / Imitate me as accurately as possible for 1 minute.
Truth or Dare: when did I look most ridiculous? / Give me 3 compliments in a villain's voice.
Truth or Dare: which moment with me was the most embarrassing? / Invent and perform our secret dance.
Truth or Dare: what did you think about me in the first 10 seconds of meeting? / Show how you act when you miss me.
Truth or Dare: in which situation would you definitely not support me? / Act out a jealousy scene without words.
Truth or Dare: which trait of mine do you find the strangest? / Repeat my typical phrase or intonation.
Truth or Dare: when were you genuinely disappointed in me? / Invent superhero names for us and introduce us.
Truth or Dare: which of my belongings would you secretly throw away? / Act out our perfect date in 10 seconds.
Truth or Dare: what is your strangest fantasy (not necessarily about me)? / Tell me a confession like in a dramatic TV show.
Truth or Dare: when did I make you laugh the hardest? / Make me laugh in 30 seconds by any means.
Truth or Dare: what do you sometimes feel ashamed of in front of me? / Give me a compliment, but like a robot.
Truth or Dare: what did you underestimate about me at first? / Invent a funny nickname for me and explain it.
Truth or Dare: in what moment did you realize you liked me? / Show how I look in the morning just after waking up.
Truth or Dare: what was the silliest argument you've ever had in a relationship? / Defend an absurd position (e.g. 'pizza without cheese is better').
Truth or Dare: when were you proud of me? / Give a motivational speech about me.
Truth or Dare: what about me would you never want to change? / Act out the scene where you confess your feelings to me for the first time.
Truth or Dare: what is the hardest thing to say to me directly? / Ask me a tricky question.
Truth or Dare: when did you underestimate me? / Act out our typical argument.
Truth or Dare: what about me seems mysterious to you? / Invent an alternative version of how we met.
Truth or Dare: when were you happiest with me? / Describe me using three strange metaphors.
Truth or Dare: what small thing about me makes you happy? / Give me 3 unexpected compliments in a row without stopping.
Truth or Dare: what about me have you still not figured out? / Act out a scene where you defend me in front of someone.
Truth or Dare: when were you a little offended by me but said nothing? / Say something nice to me, but with maximum seriousness.
Truth or Dare: if we swapped roles for a day, what's the first thing you'd do? / Show how I explain something with confidence, even when I'm wrong.
Truth or Dare: what is the strangest sound you've ever accidentally made? / Act it out now as dramatically as possible.
Truth or Dare: what silly thought have you had recently that you'd never admit? / Think out loud like a character from a TV show.
Truth or Dare: when did you last look absolutely ridiculous? / Show it now.
Truth or Dare: what is the strangest compliment you've ever received? / Give me an even stranger one.
Truth or Dare: what do you do when you think no one is watching? / Act it out now.
Truth or Dare: what is your most embarrassing childhood memory? / Tell it with maximum seriousness as if it were an epic moment.
Truth or Dare: what is your strangest habit? / Demonstrate it right now.
Truth or Dare: when did you last do something absolutely dumb? / Act it out in slow motion.
Truth or Dare: which word do you find the funniest? / Repeat it 10 times with different emotions.
Truth or Dare: what was your most embarrassing attempt at flirting? / Show what it looked like.
Truth or Dare: what did you do to impress someone, but it came across as weird? / Redo it now.
Truth or Dare: what is your strangest reaction to stress? / Show it now.
Truth or Dare: when did you look most foolish in front of other people? / Act out that scene as a theatre performance.
Truth or Dare: what is the strangest dance you've ever danced? / Do it now without any inhibitions.
Truth or Dare: what is the most embarrassing sound you make when surprised? / Act it out now as loudly and dramatically as possible.
